import sys

MOD = 998244353
INV2 = 499122177

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    return pow(base, exp, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    d = r - l + 1
    nm = n * m
    diff = d & 1  # 0 if d even, 1 if odd

    if nm % 2 == 1:
        ans = mod_pow(d, nm)
    else:
        ans = (mod_pow(d, nm) + mod_pow(diff, nm)) % MOD
        ans = ans * INV2 % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
